events.verdict: Herro (MIA) maintains a legal guarding position during Giddey's (CHI) drive to the basket and shot attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Herro (MIA) loses control of the ball and is the last player to touch it before it goes out of bounds.
Vucevic (CHI) establishes himself in Herro's (MIA) path and absorbs the contact.
Vucevic (CHI) is off-balance as he grabs the rebound and the contact with Jaquez Jr. (MIA) is marginal.
White (CHI) dribbles the ball off of Herro's (MIA) foot while it is planted on the floor.
Ware (MIA) reaches across Williams' (CHI) body and initiates illegal contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Williams (CHI) legally contests Jovic's (MIA) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Jovic's (MIA) shot attempt goes out of bounds and is not touched by Williams (CHI).
Herro (MIA) grabs Dosunmu's (CHI) arm, causing him to lose his balance.
Rozier (MIA) commits a take foul on White (CHI).
Ball (CHI) moves alongside Jovic's (MIA) path to the basket and the contact during his driving shot attempt is marginal.
Robinson (MIA) commits a take foul on White (CHI).
Vucevic (CHI) legally contests Adebayo's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
